description: Use when a BA or admin needs to document the Salesforce data model: creating field inventories, object relationship maps, ER diagrams, or analyzing field usage across objects. Triggers: 'data dictionary', 'document our data model', 'object relationship map', 'field inventory', 'ER diagram for Salesforce'. NOT for designing the model or choosing lookup vs master-detail — use data/data-model-design-patterns. NOT for generating the Mermaid or PlantUML diagram — use architect/salesforce-erd-and-diagramming. More trigger keywords: field inventory CSV, describe API, getGlobalDescribe, DescribeFieldResult, sObject describe, schema snapshot, schema drift, blank field descriptions, undocumented fields, field ownership, data dictionary review cadence.
inputs: List of objects to document (standard, custom, or both)
Access to Salesforce org Setup or exported metadata (package.xml retrieve)
Any specific documentation format required (spreadsheet, diagram, narrative)
name: data-model-documentation
official_sources: Apex Reference Guide, `DescribeFieldResult` method list — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/apexrefguide.pdf — the complete accessor list (`getReferenceTo`, `getRelationshipName`, `getRelationshipOrder`, `getInlineHelpText`, `getLength`, `isCustom`, `isCalculated`, `isNillable`, `isCascadeDelete`, `isNamePointing`, `isAccessible`, `getLocalName`) used for the field-inventory and ER-map generators, and for the fact that no `getDescription()` accessor exists (Gotchas 5, 6, 8, 9; worked-examples sections 1 and 3)

Apex Reference Guide, `Schema.getGlobalDescribe()` and `Schema.describeSObjects()` — same PDF — the object-enumeration entry point and the "call getGlobalDescribe, then describeSObjects" pattern the inventory script follows

Apex Developer Guide, "Describing sObjects Using Schema Methods" — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf — the `res.fields.getMap()` iteration idiom and the `getChildRelationships()` example that worked-examples section 1 is shaped from

Metadata API Developer Guide, `CustomObject` and `CustomField` type entries — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — the `description`, `inlineHelpText`, `businessOwnerUser`, `businessOwnerGroup`, `businessStatus`, `securityClassification`, `complianceGroup`, `referenceTo`, `relationshipName` and `formula` elements that only the retrieve path exposes (worked-examples section 4; the checker's allowed value sets)

Metadata API Developer Guide, "Sample package.xml Manifest Files" (Standard Objects / All Custom Objects) — same PDF — the wildcard-excludes-standard-objects behaviour and the non-customisable-standard-fields exclusion behind Gotcha 11, plus the Profile/PermissionSet co-retrieval note used for FLS snapshots

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform, "Compound Field Considerations and Limitations" — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — geolocation counting as three custom fields, compound fields being API-only, their absence from Schema Builder and dashboards, the Data Loader export error, and the `isFilterable()` misreport for address fields (Gotcha 7); also the standard-object field tables used to fill the gap Gotcha 1 describes

REST API Developer Guide, "sObject Describe" and "Get Object Metadata Changes" — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_rest.pdf — the `/services/data/vXX.X/sobjects/<sObject>/describe/` resource and the `If-Modified-Since` → `304 Not Modified` (empty body) drift-detection behaviour used by worked-examples section 2

Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet, SOAP API Call Limits — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf — `describeSObjects()` returns a maximum of 100 objects, which is why the inventory script batches its object list

`skills/security/data-classification-labels/SKILL.md` — owns the `SecurityClassification` / `ComplianceGroup` / `BusinessOwnerId` / `BusinessStatus` value sets and their governance; this skill consumes them as dictionary columns rather than restating them

`skills/devops/metadata-diff-between-sandboxes/SKILL.md` — owns interpretation of a two-org delta (which side is authoritative, destructive-changes manifests); worked-examples section 6 stops at producing two comparable snapshots

`agents/data-model-reviewer/AGENT.md` (Mandatory Reads item 22) and `agents/field-impact-analyzer/AGENT.md` (Step 1, FieldDefinition projection) — the two consumers of the artefacts this skill produces, and the source for the Tooling `FieldDefinition` filter and column constraints in Gotcha 10

Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html — used for Operational Excellence pillar framing and documentation as a quality practice
outputs: Field inventory: object name, field label, API name, type, required, FLS, description
Object relationship map showing Lookup, Master-Detail, and Junction relationships
ER diagram draft suitable for stakeholder review or onboarding
Field usage analysis flagging blank Description fields or undocumented custom fields
Reviewed data dictionary record with owner, classification, record volume and review date per object
Repeatable generator scripts (Apex, REST, retrieve) plus a two-snapshot drift diff
